deadline.value: The deadline for admission and Oxford scholarship consideration is 2026-12-02.
deadline.quote: 12:00 midday UK time on Wednesday 2 December 2026

entry_route.value: Applicants should hold or be predicted to achieve a first-class or strong upper second-class undergraduate degree with honours; a previous master's qualification is not required.
entry_route.quote: a first-class or strong upper second-class undergraduate degree with honours in engineering or a related discipline relevant for the proposed area of research, such as physics, materials science, computer science, applied mathematics or chemistry. a previous master's qualification is not required.

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to contact potential supervisors in their area(s) of interest before applying.
supervisor.quote: Applicants are encouraged to contact potential supervisors in their area(s) of interest to identify research projects that are best suited to their skillset and aspirations.

funding.value: Several scholarships are available to cover post-graduate tuition fees and living expenses; applicants should apply to be considered for them.
funding.quote: Several scholarships are available to cover post-graduate tuition fees and living expenses.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: DPhil in Engineering Science (Biomedical Engineering) via the Institute of Biomedical Engineering (IBME), University of Oxford.
